summary: Only part of this scope could be checked. Gogoro's own figures, relayed by the press, are confirmed: more than 2,700 swap stations (2,725 by April 2026), over 650,000 owners, about 370,000 swaps a day and 1.4 million batteries. Gogoro's first-generation battery is being retired in 2026, and the effect on owners of older models is not explained, so ask the dealer before buying a used or older Gogoro. Gogoro took about 87% of the 4,686 electric scooters registered in June 2026, so almost everything sold uses its network. Taoyuan's round runs to 31 Dec 2026 (applications to 10 Jan 2027) with up to NT$44,000 when central and city subsidies are combined and an old scooter is replaced; whether 2027 continues is unknown. The petrol-station comparison, national and per-city adoption shares, other networks, plug-in charging, apartment charging rules, rural and island coverage, policy targets, grid mix and lifecycle figures are unverified and must not be published yet.

findings.subject: Gogoro 車主數、每日換電次數、電池數
findings.valueText: 超過65萬名車主; 每日換電高達37萬次; 全台超過2,700座換電站; 逾140萬顆智慧電池
findings.quote: 目前服務超過65萬名車主，每日換電次數高達37萬次。據統計，全台已建置超過2,700座換電站，投入逾140萬顆智慧電池
findings.verifierNote: Opened; all four numbers present. 'Owners' is not active subscribers; company-supplied statement (Economist forum coverage). Consistent with 2,725 in April.

findings.subject: Gogoro 第一代電池退役與 GoStation Q
findings.valueText: 第一代電池2026年正式結束服務並全面退役; 計畫投入NT$10億發展能源網路; 熱門區域新增逾100座換電站; GoStation Q 佔地約現行1/3、220V; 先在台灣試點再推海外
findings.quote: 第一代電池已達成階段性任務，將於今年正式結束服務並全面退役，與此同時，公司計畫投入新台幣 10 億元持續發展能源網路
findings.verifierNote: Retirement and NT$1 billion confirmed. The researcher's claims 'end of 2026 Taiwan pilot' and 'Vietnam 2027' were NOT found on the page (page only says Taiwan pilot first, then overseas); dropped. Added: 100+ new stations in popular areas. Impact on owners of older Gen1-battery models is not stated; unresolved.

findings.subject: 全台電動機車新掛牌數 2026年6月
findings.quote: 2026年6月全台電動機車掛牌數達4,686輛，相較5月的4,269輛增加417輛，成長率約9.8%
findings.verifierNote: Figures confirmed, but the page opened at that URL is titled '銷售戰報／2026年6月電動機車，Gogoro市佔率逼近九成！ | 地球黃金線' (a media tally from monitoring-station registration data). The 5月 Gogoro share '84.33%' was not found; use 3,600 units only. Data is June, five months old; no later month checked.
